meta.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Philippines
meta.description: “LOL” or “Last One Laughing” is a reality show where ten comedians battle it out to make each other laugh. With no smiles allowed, they unleash their best jokes and antics, aiming to make each other crack up for six hours. It’s a hilarious battle of wit and self-control, where the last one laughing wins ONE MILLION PESOS!

videos.title: Let’s meet the Philippines’ best comedians!
videos.overview: The riot begins. Ten of the best celebrity comedians in the Philippines are caught in the wackiest meet-up of all time. And for the first time, they stay in one house for six long hours and are required to suppress the one thing they all love to do – laugh! Will they be able to contain it? Who will struggle the most?

videos.title: Humor in the house goes up 2 notches!
videos.overview: The humor in the house takes on a different level. The boys drink coffee from an “arinola” (chamber pot) and Pepe throws in his set of toilet jokes. Empoy takes the stage as a grieving superhero and comedians struggle to survive the moment. Is Empoy as strong as Rufa as a contender? Both engage in a side conversation and the red button buzzes again. Who killed who?

videos.title: Meet Vice’s sidekicks!
videos.overview: Vice makes a phone call to her sidekicks and orders them to invade the house. They perform a hilarious set and the contestants struggle to contain their laughs. Comedian Jerald takes the stage as an aerobic instructor demonstrating funny and kinky workout poses – another tough one for the comedians. Who gets the next warning card? And who gets to stay until the last hour?

videos.title: More penalties, More reds!
videos.overview: As the hours passed, the strong batch of contenders started to flake one by one. Pepe Herrera does another comedic set with plastic props coming out of his mouth. And Chad does a pageant comedy bit throwing out punchlines like a beauty queen. The house turns red and more cards are handed out by Vice Ganda. Who is it this time? Who will stay the longest and bring home one million pesos?

videos.title: Top 2 revealed!
videos.overview: All boys remain and the house literally becomes an all-male party! The house goes all-out with jokes, punchlines, antics and gimmicks, but no one is laughing! Until the house turns red again. And this time, they are down to the final two comedians. The final two comedians are revealed!

videos.title: The first-ever grand champion of LOL Philippines
videos.overview: The final hour. One comedian is a step closer to one million pesos. The eliminated contestants go back inside the house to take a shot at making the final two comedians laugh. Vice Ganda takes it up a notch and the final two comedians engage in head-to-head games. Both survive. Who will be the first-ever Last One Laughing Philippines grand winner? Let’s find out!

videos.title: The Laugh Trip Begins!
videos.overview: Ten of the Philippines' funniest comedians enter the LOL Terminal. The moment our host Vice Ganda hits the green button, it's game on. Everyone comes in locked and loaded. Long makes his move early, but the rest quickly gang up on him. Then Vice Ganda's finger finds the red button too fast. Is it a smile? Is it laughter? Who is it?

videos.title: First to Fall
videos.overview: The competition heats up as the comedians go all out, unleashing outrageous characters, wild improvisations, and non-stop bits, all while desperately trying to keep a straight face. Ooopps, did someone crack a smile? Everyone braces themselves for the first ever elimination this season.

videos.title: Chaos, Clowns and Comedy Clash
videos.overview: A surprise prank call sends the remaining comedians into a frenzy. James' hot-headed alter ego enters the game arena for a bit no one saw coming. Chaos continues as they team up for a hilarious barangay joke-off! The laughs keep coming, but so do the eliminations. Two comedians get the boot! Who will be eliminated next?

videos.title: Hihihi History Repeats Itself
videos.overview: The most feared player from Season 1 returns! Rufa Mae barely breaks a sweat as she puts every comedian's spot in serious danger. Meanwhile, Donna's stage performance makes the remaining hours even more brutal. Nobody's safe at this point!

videos.title: The Final Detour
videos.overview: With the competition entering its final stretch, the remaining contestants go head-to-head in a series of one-on-one battles, all fighting to prove who truly deserves to be crowned the Last One Laughing Season 2 champion. One slip is all it takes. Who makes it to the finale?

videos.title: The Last Laugh
videos.overview: After six hilarious and relentless hours, only three remain standing. Just when they think it's almost over, the eliminated comedians crash the finale, armed with games, distractions, and pure chaos designed to break whatever composure is left. Who will have the last laugh and take home 1 million pesos?
